title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Join our team as a Senior DevOps Engineer! We're seeking an experienced professional with strong AWS and Kubernetes expertise. Military veterans encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities:
- Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines
- Manage Kubernetes clusters on AWS
- Implement infrastructure as code with Terraform
- Mentor junior engineers

Requirements:
- 8+ years DevOps experience
- Expert AWS knowledge (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda)
- Kubernetes production experience
- Strong Python and Bash scripting
- Security clearance (Secret or higher) preferred
